description: Implementation of TaxRateDao for accessing TaxRate entities from the database, including methods for listing and retrieving tax rates based on store, country, zone, language, code, and tax class.

classes.name: TaxRateDaoImpl
classes.description: Data Access Object implementation for TaxRate entity, providing methods to query tax rates based on various attributes.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Retrieves list of TaxRate for a specific store, including all descriptions.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Retrieves list of TaxRate for a specific store filtered by language.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a TaxRate by its unique code within a store.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a TaxRate by its unique ID.

methods.name: listByCountryZoneAndTaxClass
methods.description: Retrieves tax rates associated with a specific country, zone, and tax class.

methods.name: listByCountryStateProvinceAndTaxClass
methods.description: Retrieves tax rates valid for a specific country and state/province, and associated with a particular tax class.
